audit.whatIsWrong: The entry never states which part of Decimate matters. Darius only heals off the outer blade ring; the inner handle deals reduced damage and grants him no healing.
audit.why: Riot's Decimate text: enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle, and Darius heals based on champions hit by the blade. Hugging Darius therefore removes his sustain from the trade — the exact opposite of the instinct to back away.
audit.corrected: Standing inside the handle radius denies the heal; backing to the blade ring gives it to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said "track Apprehend" without ever giving the number, so the player cannot know how long the window actually is.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. Darius maxes Decimate first, so through levels 4-9 Apprehend is usually rank 1 at 26s. A missed Apprehend is a genuinely enormous window, and Zac Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — at rank 1 Zac E is actually shorter than Darius E.
audit.corrected: Apprehend 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed; Zac E 21s at rank 1. State the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] is labelled side "Darius" but its why text read "Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight" — it describes Zac winning while the chart awards the stage to Darius.
audit.why: Level 6 is Darius's spike, not Zac's: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill. The stage text contradicted its own side label.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the why so it describes the Darius level-6 spike that the side label already asserts.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] had title "Pick up blobs to sustain" attached to the description "Darius wastes Apprehend (Pull) — commit the full pattern immediately", and dontsFull[1] had title "Trade his early even" attached to "Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown". Both are template mismatches where title and body describe different things.
audit.why: A player reading the Do/Don't list gets a title that does not match its explanation, which makes the advice unusable.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed each title at the body text that is already there.

audit.why: Win rate 50.6% over 251 games is a genuinely even lane and the TRICKY/7.5 difficulty framing is defensible given Zac has to survive a losing early.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill, so at 5 stacks he has a real execute line on you.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. E-knock after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his only gap-closer, and he maxes Q first so it stays 26s for most of lane. - Your Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Darius wastes Apprehend (Pull) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Blobs are your sustain and your revive margin — trade along them.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain Darius's as Apprehend sets up his bleed execute.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay Darius's — rank-1 Apprehend every 26s starts the bleed.

edits.before: Post-Sunfire you can start scaling out; use W Unstable Matter percent-HP damage and kite his Q outer edge, but he still wins a straight all-in if he lands E.
edits.after: Post-Sunfire you scale out; W grinds percent-HP off his pool, and hugging him puts you on Q's handle so he gets no heal — but a clean Apprehend still wins the all-in.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 belong to Darius: his Decimate (Q) heals off you and out-trades your auto, and your best move is to soak XP at range and only Q-poke when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 belong to Darius, but Decimate only heals off its outer blade: poke with Q from 800 range, stand inside the handle if you are stuck in melee, and never sit on the blade ring.

notes: Two template mismatches fixed in the full layer (dosFull[2] title vs body, dontsFull[1] title vs body) — worth grepping for the same pattern across other Zac entries, it looks generator-wide rather than Darius-specific. Separately: the full-layer phases[] sides (Darius/Skill/Zac/Zac/Darius/Zac/Zac) do not match the content-layer win[] array (Darius x6, Zac) for this matchup. I only corrected the internal contradiction inside phases[4]; reconciling the two layers' charts against each other is a structural decision I left alone. Not asserted anywhere: whether Zac's Cell Division bloblet state denies Noxian Guillotine its kill-refresh — that is exactly the sort of interaction the kit file marks unknown, and I could not verify it, so the entry says nothing about it.
